audience.text: Java developers building server-side or desktop applications that require PDF document generation, manipulation, and extraction without third-party runtime dependencies.

capabilities.text: Developers can create new PDF documents from scratch, add pages, and insert text, tables, and other content elements.
capabilities.title: Create and modify PDF documents

capabilities.text: The library supports extracting plain text using TextAbsorber and extracting images as XImage objects from PDF pages.
capabilities.title: Extract text and images

capabilities.text: Developers can read and populate AcroForm fields including TextBoxField and RadioButtonOptionField through the Form interface.
capabilities.title: Work with form fields

capabilities.text: The library supports creating and configuring widget annotations with customizable border and background characteristics.
capabilities.title: Manage annotations

capabilities.text: Developers can create table structures with cells, add text fragments and form fields to cells, and inspect cell contents.
capabilities.title: Build and inspect table content

capabilities.text: Developers can set and read border styles and colors for annotations including radio button options using the Border class.
capabilities.title: Configure annotation borders

limitations.text: No OCR functionality is provided; recognition of text in scanned images requires a dedicated OCR library.
Concurrency is not supported for a single Document instance; separate instances must be used for parallel processing.
Text replacement with non-Latin scripts may differ from a reference renderer due to limited bidirectional reordering and shaping support.

problems_solved.text: Enables programmatic creation and modification of PDF documents including text, tables, forms, annotations, and images using a consistent Java API.
Supports extraction of text and images from existing PDFs through dedicated absorber and resource access classes.
Provides form field population and interaction capabilities for AcroForm fields including text boxes and radio button options.
Offers annotation support including widget annotations with customizable border and background characteristics.

product_summary.text: Aspose.PDF FOSS for Java is a free, open-source, pure-Java library for creating, reading, and modifying PDF documents targeting ISO 32000-1:2008 compliance.

uncertainties: The exact scope of partial tagged PDF / logical structure support beyond basic structure tree readability is not specified.
The extent of PDF/X validation and conversion test coverage is not confirmed despite API support.
Whether all public symbols listed in the inherited README are fully implemented in this FOSS edition is not verifiable from facts.

workflows.name: Create PDF from scratch
workflows.text: Developers instantiate a Document, add pages, insert text fragments, and save the result as a PDF file.

workflows.name: Extract text from PDF
workflows.text: Developers load a PDF, apply a TextAbsorber to its pages, and retrieve the extracted text content.

workflows.name: Extract images from PDF
workflows.text: Developers iterate over page resources to access XImage objects and save them to image files.

workflows.name: Populate form fields
workflows.text: Developers load a PDF with forms, access the Form object, retrieve specific fields, set values, and save the filled form.

workflows.name: Add form fields to table cells
workflows.text: Developers create table cells, add text fragments and radio button option fields to them, and maintain insertion order.

workflows.name: Configure widget annotation properties
workflows.text: Developers create widget annotations, set border and background colors, and read back their characteristics.
